GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well landed in front settled down second taking the trail big keen 2 Lengths (1400m), settled better Soon After & enjoyed a perfect run To The Turn , Straightened Up going underneath Leaders & Took over Soon After , raced way to the line # enjoyed gun run
Jumped Fast Restrained thus Settled Down 3 Wide 3 Lengths off leader/winner Soon After in 1x1 (8 Lengths 4th x 800m), Clear All The Way Never Likely into 3rd x 100m, # not run to suit
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Peter Sinclair) Jumped ok let drift back settled down third last Two Wide 5 Lengths (1000m), coming up Wide out To The Turn trying to run on Straight , Under Whip wacked away Without threat # stuck to task ok

Jumped evenly. Pushed early & raced keenly behind Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Raced keenly & Held Ground midrace until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & chsed steadily in last 200m. # Best work last 150m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths ? Straight Out The Back 12 Lengths within 8 Lengths x 400m 13th into Straight clear run home Outside Kept Finding Closest on line but was Never Likely - # pace on, ran on
Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 3rd last 12 Lengths 600m 11th 10 Lengths home turn 10th Middle Of Track Straight to run on well final 200m # back/ran on well

Jumped okay, Restrained & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 6.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and made up a couple of lengths in Straight # never a real threat

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, railed to 5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn then shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME) # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , overraced Worse than midfield rails 5 Lengths 800m, angled off fence and to Middle Of Track from the 600m, looked place chance soon after Straightening Up but just kept grinding away last 200m and did not finish well enough # grinding effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in. Raced keenly during the early and middle stages. Near the 500m, improved onto heels, shifted out, bumped and was checked.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 0.8 Lengths across to the fence improved to park 4 Lengths off the lead (1000m), off rail Soon After very keen though, no closer Straight leader kicked, faded (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # too keen/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: C/O/T-further forward with blinkers on 1st time. Bumped on jumping and settle in a midfield position. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Rdr reported gelding didn’t appreciate track conditions and may be better suited in races over a further distance.
